render.text: [warmly] A fine afternoon on the chain. Our man walks the ridge, cane in hand... entirely UNTROUBLED by the market.
[matter-of-fact] Two lines. What the holder base PAID for it, and what it is worth today. The gap is profit... and all of it belongs to somebody else.
[amused] Holders are up ninety percent on what they paid. And a newcomer, bless him, chooses THIS precise moment to buy.
[dry] This... is what buying from people in profit looks like. The gentleman is fine. PROBABLY.
[confident] Daylight. It reads what the holders paid, before you buy. [amused] Do try to look behind you.
